subject: Error Message: estimation pearson correlation did not converge

messages.subject: Error Message: estimation pearson correlation did not converge
parts:
Lavaan Group,

I am fitting a model with four latent variables and some of the observed variables are binary. I am fitting this using the WLSMV estimator and using the "pairwise" option for missing data. The model fit is good (CFI: 0.952, TLI: 0.945,  RMSEA: 0.035) but I get an error message stating "lavaan WARNING: estimation pearson correlation did not converge for variables v5 and v6." 

It seems that the error goes away if I remove the "ordered" statement or remove the "pairwise" option, but I would ideally need both of these. Removing the residual covariances does not solve the problem. Any idea why this is happening? My syntax is below.

Thank you!

cog4f <- '
# latent variables
mem =~ v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 + v6 + v7 + v8
lan =~ v9 + v10 + v11 + v12 + v13 + v14 + v15 + v16 + v17
vis =~ v18 + v19 + v20
exfx =~ v21 + v22 + v23 + v24 + v25 + v26 + v27

# covariance of latent variables
mem~~lan + vis + exfx
lan~~vis + exfx
vis~~exfx

# residual covariances
v1~~v5 
v6~~v1
v5~~v6
v20~~v19
v21~~v22
v2~~v7
v3~~v8
'
cog4f.fit <- cfa(cog4f, data=mi, estimator="WLSMV", missing="pairwise", ordered=c("v10", "v11", "v12", "v13", "v14", "v15", "v16", "v17", "v18"), parameterization="delta")
